title: Reconcile ordinary named-root refusal wording, coverage, and published-name edge cases
outcome: Reconcile the four whole-13 Low findings with the eventual ordinary named-root selection specification. Keep any applicable corrections and deterministic coverage in scope, and document findings displaced by the approved design.
acceptance: Reconcile whether an in-flight or failed re-name can remove still-published authority for a named root from the opening ambiguity decision. Preserve the first-publication fence.
Where applicable, ordinary refusal wording distinguishes report authority from independent verification and the source-root reason header identifies the actual decision owners.
Any surviving pending-selection, enqueue recheck, and close recheck fences have deterministic behavioral coverage. Record why any finding no longer applies after the core changes.
